roles.description_text:
About Globex Labs
Globex Labs makes AI agents for operations teams. A fictional company for the LVLme demo.
About the role
Lead the rollout of our AI agents at logistics and retail customers across Australia and New Zealand, from the first pilot to full production.
What you'll do
- Run deployment programs with customer operations teams, from pilot to full rollout
- Design how we measure whether an agent is working, and report it to customer leaders
- Turn what you learn on site into product requests the engineering team can act on
What you'll bring
- 5+ years running programs or projects with operations teams
- A record of rolling out software across several sites or teams
- Hands-on experience evaluating AI systems or large language models
- Clear writing for both engineers and customer executives
Nice to have
- Experience in logistics, warehousing or retail operations
- Comfort reading Python scripts
Location
Sydney, or remote within Australia, with travel to customer sites. You need the right to work in Australia.
